title: Lumen_NM
description: Lumen_NM is a light Minecraft shader focused on enhancing the atmosphere through an improved water coloration system and subtle world-lighting affects. Increasing visibility and contrast during the day.
body:
🌙 Lumen_NM

A subtle, lightweight shader that gently enhances Minecraft’s UI and water colors.

Lumen_NM is a minimalist shader designed to complement Minecraft’s look rather than overhaul it. It focuses on small, tasteful visual improvements that keep the game feeling clean, readable, and unmistakably vanilla.

✨ Features

UI Color Enhancements  
Soft, subtle color adjustments that make menus and HUD elements feel cleaner and more cohesive.
(Based on your description: “subtle minor changes to Minecraft’s UI… mostly just color changing”) 

Improved Water Coloration  
Water appears clearer and more vibrant, giving oceans and rivers a refreshing look.
(“changing the water color”) 

Vanilla‑Friendly Aesthetic  
No dramatic lighting, no heavy post‑processing — just small enhancements that support Minecraft’s original style.
(“supposed to complement Minecraft not redo the entire UI”) 

Extremely Lightweight  
Designed to run smoothly on virtually any system.

📥 Installation Guide

1. Install a Shader‑Compatible Loader
Choose one:

Iris Shaders (Recommended)
Download the Iris installer

Select your Minecraft version

Launch the game once to generate the shaderpacks folder

OptiFine
Download the OptiFine .jar

Run it to create an OptiFine profile

Launch Minecraft with that profile

2. Download Lumen_NM

Go to the Versions tab on this Modrinth page

Download the latest .zip file

Do not unzip it

3. Add the Shader to Minecraft
   
Launch Minecraft with Iris or OptiFine

Go to:
Options → Video Settings → Shader Packs

Click Open Shader Pack Folder

Drop the Lumen_NM.zip file inside

Select Lumen_NM from the shader list

4. Optional Tweaks

Lumen_NM is intentionally simple.
If you want to adjust colors or water appearance, open the shader settings menu.

5. Enjoy a Cleaner, Brighter Vanilla Experience

Your UI and water will now look subtly enhanced without changing the soul of Minecraft.
